sections.title: The letters mb
paragraphs: The letters mb make the sound /m/ in the word (lamb) /læm/, which means a young sheep. This letter group makes only one sound. The second letter is a silent letter, which is a letter that you write but do not say. You only pronounce the first letter.

sections.title: How to say mb
paragraphs: Close both lips firmly together. Let the air flow smoothly out through your nose. Turn your voice on so your vocal cords vibrate. Touch your throat with your hand to feel the shake. Keep your lips closed and do not pop them open at the end.

sections.title: Spelling of mb
paragraphs: This spelling appears at the end of a word or root. You say the sound /m/ in the word (lamb) /læm/. You also hear this sound in the word (comb) /koʊm/. The final consonant is always completely silent in this position.

sections.title: Common mistakes with mb
paragraphs: Many learners try to pronounce the final written letter as an extra burst. Do not release your lips with a puff of air at the finish. Keep your lips closed and end the word softly with the voice humming in your nose.
